items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: I said, why don't we put the two bands together? ... so when we went to the Park Plaza... so at that time you had bands like Montecino... You got the job at the Park Plaza so, ah Montecino was out and you was in.

ctx.x: So Mario tell me: "Macho, the band is ready", so I went to the Park Plaza and - lucky, one of those lucky moments - I went to the Park Plaza, Montecino happened to be the leader, he had a - there was postponed one of the dance on Saturday. That was a Monday, so I went up there because I was a regular player for a band, and asked the owner that I have a band and the guy paid me no attention, so in that particular moment Montecino came and said: "Hey, Macho - hello, how are you? How is your guerrilla? you know, he…
When you say - when they were saying guerrilla, what exactly does that mean?
